name: MemoryMate-TA
description: "MemoryMate-TA is a synthetic, fictional dataset for building and evaluating the language components of a voice-first memory companion for people living with dementia, in English, Tamil and Tanglish (Tamil written in Latin letters and mixed with English). It has six parts: (A) 2,138 patient utterances labelled with 11 intents (726 English, 720 Tamil, 692 Tanglish; train\/val\/test 1,396\/377\/365); (B) the same utterances with BIO entity tags for eight labels (PERSON, RELATION, MEDICINE, TIME, DATE, PLACE, OBJECT, EVENT); (C) memory profiles of four fictional patients, 411 facts about family, medicines and schedules, appointments, routines, object locations and recent events, each with a caregiver; (D) 304 questions against the profiles with gold fact ids and gold answers, including unanswerable questions for refusal testing; (F) 301 sentences with ambiguous words (tablet, glass, pressure, check, ...) and sense labels; (G) 308 caregiver notes with gold relation triples. Rows come from templates and from paraphrasing with Gemma models; every row records its source, generator, language and split, and paraphrases of one seed stay in one split. The dataset was used to train and benchmark MuRIL, XLM-R, mBERT and TF-IDF intent classifiers, CRF and MuRIL+CRF entity taggers, BM25 \/ dense \/ hybrid retrievers and grounded answer generation with Gemma 4 and Qwen 2.5. No real patient, caregiver or medical record was used."
